git_scope: Full clone of main, checked out at its head for issue #501, which names no revision. The issue's three sides are those of 41019fb5808e6b62b50dfc7b5bcb0c0f880d5314, the head when it was opened; c3d17ab replaced all three certificates with smaller ones. Every file of the tree but .gitignore is in the scope and retained under the MIT licence. No source program was executed.
license: MIT (LICENSE, Copyright (c) 2026 Daniil Ostashev, added in c6893aa24ec2b2822ef42ab695c828de1ccb9015); the README says it covers the verification code and the record packings and certificates. The files are retained byte-identical with the licence beside them. The README credits Daniil Ostashev with the packings, names the soft-to-rigid method of Yohei Nakajima, this project's cell linear program and Ryan Xu's certificate construction as the methods used, and states no AI assistance.
claims: At c3d17ab08bd5db65dc5ffe69e41f7b2ff0c2fc49 the README states smaller sides from exact rational certificates at the exact optimum of each packing's contact topology: s(155) <= 12.952425406958457, s(156) <= 12.979172613644427 and s(211) <= 14.996336721336316, rounded up; each records/n0NNN.sqcert gives the exact side, dilated by 1 + 1e-60 from the 60-digit optimum.

The README says the packings were constructed from scratch (an explicit V-shaped tilted band with aligned corner blocks chosen by an integer program, no existing record geometry used), re-hardened on a GPU and polished by linear programming, and that its own C++ GMP checker and an 80-digit mpmath cross-check accept them. These are author reports; the KKT statement is not a bound.
